title: AiRWA Announces Best Life Acquisition to Diversify Revenue Beyond AI Business

content_html:
Fiona Craig

Mon, July 27, 2026 at 10:36 AM EDT 3 min read

AiRWA (NASDAQ:YYAI) has agreed to acquire import-export company Best Life in a transaction valued at up to $130 million, combining upfront payments with performance-based earn-outs as the company broadens its business portfolio alongside its artificial intelligence operations.

Key Investor Takeaways

  • AiRWA (NASDAQ:YYAI) signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 97% stake in Best Life for an initial purchase price of $50 million.

  • The acquisition includes up to $80 million in contingent earn-out payments tied to future revenue milestones.

  • Best Life brings an established international import-export business with operations across Asia and expansion plans in North America and New Zealand.

  • The deal supports AiRWA's strategy to diversify revenue beyond AI technology licensing and digital advertising.

  • Management said its AI subsidiary, 26 Rafael, continues to perform in line with expectations while remaining a long-term growth driver.

Why YYAI Stock Is In Focus

AiRWA announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hongkong Best Life Trade Co., Limited, an import-export company specializing in consumer and commercial goods traded between Japan, Hong Kong, and mainland China.

Under the agreement, AiRWA will acquire a 97% interest in Best Life through its holding company. The company will pay $30 million at closing and an additional $20 million within 90 days, with further contingent payments of $30 million if Best Life generates $10 million in fiscal 2026 revenue and $50 million if it reaches $25 million in fiscal 2027 revenue.

Best Life has operated for more than a decade and maintains formal cooperation agreements with customers including Alibaba Health Hong Kong, AlipayHK, Tmall, Taobao, and Cainiao. The company also operates a subsidiary in the United Kingdom and is establishing wholly owned subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, and New Zealand. Management projects annual revenue to exceed $100 million within the next three fiscal years based on its current business plans.

AiRWA said the acquisition complements its AI data training operations while expanding its exposure to businesses tied to the broader economy.

Why This Matters For Investors

The acquisition represents a strategic shift toward greater revenue diversification as AiRWA seeks to reduce its dependence on technology licensing activities, where management cited increased counterparty risk, and social media advertising, where profitability has faced pressure despite resilient revenue.

Adding an operating business with an international customer base could provide an additional source of revenue alongside the company's AI-focused operations. The performance-based earn-out structure also limits a significant portion of the purchase price to the achievement of future financial milestones, potentially aligning acquisition costs with business performance.

AiRWA（纳斯达克股票代码：YYAI）已同意以高达 1.3 亿美元的交易收购进出口公司 Best Life，随着该公司在人工智能业务的同时扩大业务组合，将预付款与基于绩效的盈利相结合。

主要投资者要点

  • AiRWA（纳斯达克股票代码：YYAI）签署最终协议，以 5000 万美元的初始收购价收购 Best Life 97% 的股权。
  • 此次收购包括与未来收入里程碑相关的高达 8000 万美元的或有盈利付款。
  • Best Life 带来了成熟的国际进出口业务，业务遍及亚洲，并计划在北美和新西兰进行扩张。
  • 该交易支持了 AiRWA 的战略，即在人工智能技术许可和数字广告之外实现收入多元化。
  • 管理层表示，其人工智能子公司 26 Rafael 的表现继续符合预期，同时仍然是长期增长动力。

为什么 YYAI 股票成为焦点

AiRWA 宣布达成收购香港 Best Life Trade Co., Limited 的最终协议，该公司是一家专门从事日本、香港和中国大陆之间消费品和商业商品贸易的进出口公司。

根据协议，AiRWA将通过其控股公司收购Best Life 97%的股权。 该公司将在交易完成时支付 3000 万美元，并在 90 天内额外支付 2000 万美元，如果 Best Life 2026 财年收入达到 1000 万美元，则进一步支付 3000 万美元，如果 2027 财年收入达到 2500 万美元，则进一步支付 5000 万美元。

百世生活已运营十多年，与阿里健康香港、支付宝香港、天猫、淘宝、菜鸟等客户保持正式合作协议。 该公司还在英国设有子公司，并正在美国、加拿大和新西兰设立全资子公司。 根据目前的业务计划，管理层预计未来三个财年的年收入将超过 1 亿美元。

AiRWA 表示，此次收购补充了其人工智能数据培训业务，同时扩大了与更广泛的经济相关的业务。

为什么这对投资者很重要

此次收购代表了向更大收入多元化的战略转变，因为 AiRWA 寻求减少对技术许可活动和社交媒体广告的依赖，技术许可活动的管理层指出交易对手风险增加，而社交媒体广告的盈利能力却面临压力，尽管收入有弹性。

增加具有国际客户群的运营业务可以为该公司以人工智能为重点的业务提供额外的收入来源。 基于绩效的盈利结构还将收购价格的很大一部分限制为实现未来财务里程碑，从而可能使收购成本与业务绩效保持一致。
